title: Takeover Protections and Asset Prices
authors: Assaf Eisdorfer; Erwan Morellec; Alexei Zhdanov
eligible_reason: Table 5 reports a diff-in-diff regression of state-level distressed-portfolio market betas on ATOL (BC antitakeover law in effect; state-specific passage years 1985-1997, with never-adopting states) with state and month fixed effects and no covariates (MainCode.sas lines 949-952). This is a static TWFE with staggered binary adoption. The companion Table 5 column adds time-varying state controls and anticipation dummies (ineligible).
design_notes: CRSP/Compustat monthly firm panel merged with state of incorporation and BC law passage years (TYEAR); firm-level ATOL = 1 if law in effect. Table 5: firms in the top CHS distress quintile are aggregated to state-month portfolios (size-weighted means; rolling monthly betas from StatePortfolioBeta.sas), betas trimmed to [-10,10], giving 15,095 state-months. Two proc glm models: (i) absorb incorp, class date, atol + state_lsize + state_l_qblvg + year_l1 + year_l2 (ineligible); (ii) class incorp date, atol only (eligible). Tables 2/4 portfolio sorts, Table 3 Fama-MacBeth, Table 6 event study around law announcements (t-tests), Tables 7-9 bond issue spreads (proc surveyreg with year/sic2 class effects, firm clustering). SAS logs contain no coefficient output. Sample TYEAR values observed in the 100-row sample: 1985, 1986, 1987, 1988, 1989, 1991, 1997 plus missing (never treated).
estimators_reported: TWFE static (proc glm, state and month FE, no controls)
TWFE with time-varying controls and anticipation dummies

specs.outcome_label: monthly market beta of the value-weighted portfolio of distressed firms (CHS top quintile, r_chs=4) incorporated in the state
specs.treatment_definition: ATOL = 1 if a business combination (BC) antitakeover law is in effect in the state of incorporation in that month (TYEAR = year the BC law passed, state-specific, 1985-1997; states without a BC law never treated); state-month value is the size-weighted mean of firm-level atol within state-month (proc means, equals 0/1 since all firms in a state share the law)
specs.fe: incorp (state) + date (month) via proc glm class incorp date
specs.cluster: none (conventional OLS SEs from proc glm)
specs.sample_condition: state-month portfolio panel of distressed firms (r_chs=4), state betas trimmed to [-10, 10]; 15,095 state-months per SAS log; firms with year >= 1988 filters in other tables (Table 5 construction starts from distress_state2j)
specs.data_file: distress_state_7 (sample of 100 rows shipped as distress_state_7_sample.sas7bdat; built from distress_state2j and state_beta_distress)
specs.reported_location: Table 5 (diff-in-diff regressions, state-distress portfolios), the column without controls
specs.notes: proc glm data=asie.distress_state_7; class incorp date; model state_beta_vw = atol incorp date / solution. The other Table 5 model (lines 942-947) adds state_lsize, state_l_qblvg and anticipation dummies year_l1, year_l2 (ineligible). The README notes an equal-weighted beta (state_beta_ew) also exists in the intermediate data but only the VW beta is modelled in the shipped code.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (state_lsize, state_l_qblvg) and extra treatment regressors (year_l1, year_l2 anticipation dummies)
cross-section of bond issues with year and SIC2 class effects but no unit FE; many issue-level controls; Table 9 adds atol x covenant interactions

data_files: 5 *_sample.sas7bdat files with 10-100 rows each (distress_state2j_sample 100x29, distress_state_7_sample 100x8, sdc_bonds_issues11_sample 10x25, abret_state_port_full4_sample 10x10, ind_targets_gain_mm2_sample 10x3); full datasets not shipped
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Regression extraction file was empty because the code is SAS; specs identified by reading MainCode.sas. Which Table 5 column corresponds to the no-controls model must be confirmed from the article.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: BC laws passed 1985-1991 in about 30 states plus later adopters (e.g., 1997); exact count not recoverable from the 100-row sample files.
data_files_note: Underlying data are licensed (CRSP, Compustat, SDC Platinum, Execucomp, Thomson Reuters, ISS). Only illustrative samples are shipped.
software_notes: SAS (proc glm, proc surveyreg, proc reg, proc sql); figures in LaTeX/TikZ
priority_note: Eligible TWFE spec exists but data are licensed and only 100-row samples are shipped; no published coefficients in the package.
